---
title: "Oxoscan data extraction"
author: "Matt Foster"
date: "2025-05-23"
output: html_document
---

```{r extract-pad-sum-save, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Use current working directory
folder_path <- getwd()

# List all .txt files
txt_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Extract 204.087 column with name and store length
extracted_list <- list()
max_len <- 0

for (file_path in txt_files) {
  df <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  
  if (!"204.087" %in% colnames(df)) {
    stop(paste("Column 204.087 not found in", file_path))
  }
  
  # Shortened name: first 2 parts of filename
  short_name <- strsplit(basename(file_path), "_")[[1]] %>%
    .[1:2] %>%
    paste(collapse = "_")
  
  values <- df[["204.087"]]
  extracted_list[[short_name]] <- values
  max_len <- max(max_len, length(values))
}

# Pad each column to max_len with NA
padded_list <- lapply(extracted_list, function(x) {
  length(x) <- max_len  # this pads with NAs
  x
})

# Combine into matrix
merged_matrix <- as_tibble(padded_list)

# Save full merged matrix
write.csv(merged_matrix, "merged_204.087_matrix.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Sum columns (ignoring NAs)
column_sums <- colSums(merged_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

# Save column sums
sum_df <- tibble(Sample = names(column_sums), Total_204.087 = as.numeric(column_sums))
write.csv(sum_df, "204.087_column_sums.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Preview result
print(sum_df)
```
